papers.title: General OCR Theory: Towards OCR-2.0 via a Unified End-to-end Model
papers.relevance_note: Primary end-to-end OCR challenger for dense scans, region prompting, formulas, and markdown-style structured output.

papers.title: PaddleOCR-VL: Boosting Multilingual Document Parsing via a 0.9B Ultra-Compact Vision-Language Model
papers.relevance_note: Layout-heavy coarse-to-fine document parser and the closest literature match to the local PaddleOCR-VL lane.

papers.title: MinerU2.5: A Decoupled Vision-Language Model for Efficient High-Resolution Document Parsing
papers.relevance_note: Best-fit reference for coarse-to-fine parsing and the MinerU challenger lane served by Aegis.

papers.title: OmniParser: A Unified Framework for Text Spotting, Key Information Extraction and Table Recognition
papers.relevance_note: Unified parser reference for text spotting, KIE, and table recognition; included as a literature-only challenger in this first pass.

papers.title: Multimodal OCR: Parse Anything from Documents
papers.relevance_note: Latest unified parse-anything document model in the research set; literature-only until a runnable local implementation is added.

papers.title: PubTables-1M: Towards comprehensive table extraction from unstructured documents
papers.relevance_note: Reference paper behind the Microsoft Table Transformer family used by Apollo's local table reconstruction lane.

papers.title: OCRBench: On the Hidden Mystery of OCR in Large Multimodal Models
papers.relevance_note: Foundational multimodal OCR benchmark used to frame literal OCR, multilingual, handwriting, and reasoning limitations.

papers.title: OCRBench v2: An Improved Benchmark for Evaluating Large Multimodal Models on Visual Text Localization and Reasoning
papers.relevance_note: Benchmark framing for localization, handwriting extraction, layout perception, and reasoning-heavy OCR tasks.

papers.title: OmniDocBench: Benchmarking Diverse PDF Document Parsing with Comprehensive Annotations
papers.relevance_note: Core document parsing comparison benchmark for diverse PDFs and modular-vs-end-to-end trade studies.

papers.title: Real5-OmniDocBench: A Full-Scale Physical Reconstruction Benchmark for Robust Document Parsing in the Wild
papers.relevance_note: Physical-world robustness benchmark covering scanning, warping, screen photography, illumination, and skew.

papers.title: DocLayNet: A Large Human-Annotated Dataset for Document-Layout Analysis
papers.relevance_note: Layout evaluation reference for diverse real-world document structures beyond arXiv-style scientific PDFs.
